vim.definition:
n a healthy capacity for vigorous activity
n an imaginative lively style (especially style of writing)
vim.translation: n. 精力, 生气, 精神

vimen.definition: n. A long, slender, flexible shoot or branch.

viminal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to twigs; consisting of twigs; producing
   twigs.
viminal.translation: 维米纳尔山(罗马七丘之一)

vimineous.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to twigs; made of pliant twigs.
a. Producing long, slender twigs or shoots.
vimineous.translation: a. 柔韧长枝条做的, 柔韧长枝条的

vimtrump's cells.translation: [医] 维姆特兰普氏细胞, 鲁惹氏细胞(蛙毛细管壁的收缩细胞)
